strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В отличие от первого люка открытая опасн: Unlike the first manhole case, the exposed hazard no longer remains; another emergency repair request is not a required correct action.
strings.В учебном деле исходная фотография сдела: In this training case, the original photograph was taken before the repair. The report and post-repair photograph concern the same manhole: the number and landmarks match, the cover is secured, and the walkway is clear.
strings.В этой смене вы готовите проект решения: In this shift, you prepare a draft decision for the authorized head and organizational steps for the specified body. You do not order inspections or penalties on behalf of another agency. No real messages are sent.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Действия зависят от актуального состояни: Actions depend on the current condition: a confirmed repair requires a reply, not a duplicate request.

strings.Заявитель просил устранить отсутствие кр: The applicant asked for the missing cover to be replaced and to be informed of completion. There is no request for compensation or allegation of another continuing fault.

What condition is confirmed by the latest materials? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.

strings.На исходном снимке объекта ещё нет крышк: The original photograph still shows no cover. The later report and photograph match the place and number and confirm completed repairs. The old photograph does not invalidate the verification result.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью об общем сроке рассмотрен: Find the article on the general deadline for reviewing a written submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Направить понятное сообщение без обвинен: Send a clear message without blaming the applicant
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Нет основания повторять аварийную меру б: Without new information, there is no basis for repeating the emergency measure.
strings.Новый материал относится к тому же объек: The new material relates to the same asset.
strings.Обвинить заявителя в заведомо ложном обр: Accuse the applicant of knowingly making a false appeal solely because the photograph is old.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Объявить повторное обращение запрещённым: Declare that any further appeal is permanently prohibited
strings.Отклонить сообщение, потому что однажды: Reject the message because it has already been repaired once.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.По приложенному свежему акту крышка закр: The recent report attached says the cover is secured and the walkway is clear; the case contains no other reported defects.
strings.Подготовить ответ о подтверждённом резул: Prepare a reply describing the confirmed outcome
strings.Подготовить содержательный ответ профиль: Prepare a substantive reply from the relevant department confirming what was completed, and close the current follow-up for this issue.

strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.

strings.Рассмотреть новое состояние объекта и пе: Examine the asset’s new condition and pass on information about the renewed risk; the earlier repair does not disprove the new evidence.
strings.Ремонт не мог состояться, пока заявитель: The repair cannot have happened while the applicant still has the old photograph.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сверить место и время исходного снимка с: Compare the location and time of the original photograph with the report
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Снова требовать ремонт без сопоставления: Demand another repair without comparing the recent report.
strings.Сообщить о подтверждённом устранении и з: Report the confirmed repair and close follow-up only for the issue that has been examined.

Report the confirmed remedy and end monitoring only for the matter reviewed. Unlike the first manhole case, the exposed hazard no longer remains; a repeat emergency report is not a mandatory correct action.
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
